description: In silico tryptic digest of human Q6ZMQ8-1 and mouse NP_031403.2 AATK to quantify how many species-distinguishing peptides a re-search of the PMID:35902728 GFP-Trap mass spectrometry data could use
code:
import requests, re, time
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def uni(acc):
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta", timeout=120)
    return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:])

def ncbi_prot(acc):
    r = requests.get("https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi",
                     params={"db": "protein", "id": acc, "rettype": "fasta", "retmode": "text"}, timeout=120)
    time.sleep(0.4)
    return "".join(l.strip() for l in r.text.strip().split("\n")[1:])

H1 = uni("Q6ZMQ8")                 # human canonical, 1374 aa
M  = ncbi_prot("NP_031403.2")      # mouse 1317 aa, = BC080846 CDS
H2 = ncbi_prot("NP_004911.2")      # human 1271 aa
print("lengths:", len(H1), len(M), len(H2))

def trypsin(seq, missed=0, minlen=7, maxlen=40):
    sites = [0] + [i+1 for i in range(len(seq)-1) if seq[i] in "KR" and seq[i+1] != "P"] + [len(seq)]
    peps = set()
    for i in range(len(sites)-1):
        for m in range(missed+1):
            j = i + 1 + m
            if j < len(sites):
                p = seq[sites[i]:sites[j]]
                if minlen <= len(p) <= maxlen:
                    peps.add(p)
    return peps

hp, mp, h2p = trypsin(H1), trypsin(M), trypsin(H2)
shared   = hp & mp
h_only   = hp - mp
m_only   = mp - hp
print(f"\nfully tryptic peptides 7-40 aa, no missed cleavages")
print(f"  human Q6ZMQ8-1 : {len(hp)}")
print(f"  mouse NP_031403.2: {len(mp)}")
print(f"  shared          : {len(shared)}  ({100*len(shared)/len(hp):.1f}% of human peptides)")
print(f"  human-specific  : {len(h_only)}")
print(f"  mouse-specific  : {len(m_only)}")

# N-terminal discrimination: peptides from human residues 1-103 (present in Q6ZMQ8-1, absent from NP_004911.2)
nterm = trypsin(H1[:120]) - trypsin(H2)
print(f"\npeptides diagnostic for the human 1374 aa start (residues 1-120 region, absent from NP_004911.2): {len(nterm)}")
for p in sorted(nterm, key=len)[:8]:
    print("   ", p, f"(start {H1.find(p)+1})")

print(f"\nhuman 1271 vs 1374 shared peptides: {len(h2p & hp)} of {len(h2p)} ({100*len(h2p & hp)/len(h2p):.1f}%)")

# ---- figure ----
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(10, 4.2))
axes[0].bar(["shared\nhuman/mouse", "human\nspecific", "mouse\nspecific"],
            [len(shared), len(h_only), len(m_only)],
            color=["#999999", "#3b6ea5", "#c06c3e"])
axes[0].set_ylabel("tryptic peptides (7-40 aa)")
axes[0].set_title("Species-distinguishing peptides,\nAATK human 1374 aa vs mouse 1317 aa", fontsize=10)
for i, v in enumerate([len(shared), len(h_only), len(m_only)]):
    axes[0].text(i, v + 1, str(v), ha="center", fontsize=9)

axes[1].bar(["shared\n1374 vs 1271", "unique to the\n1374 aa start"],
            [len(h2p & hp), len(nterm)], color=["#999999", "#4a8a52"])
axes[1].set_ylabel("tryptic peptides (7-40 aa)")
axes[1].set_title("Start-site discrimination within human AATK,\nQ6ZMQ8-1 vs NP_004911.2", fontsize=10)
for i, v in enumerate([len(h2p & hp), len(nterm)]):
    axes[1].text(i, v + 1, str(v), ha="center", fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
